description.value: Finance automation company founded in 2010 and headquartered in Foster City, California; sells software for accounts payable and global payments, mainly to mid-market and fast-growing companies.
Finance automation platform covering accounts payable, mass payments, procurement, expenses and treasury in one connected suite, with AI agents for finance tasks.
American multinational financial technology company headquartered in Foster City, California. It provides accounts payable, procurement, expense management and global payments automation software.
Finance automation company headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area (Foster City) that sells accounts payable and mass-payout software.
American multinational financial technology company headquartered in Foster City, California, with offices in several other cities.
Finance automation company offering software for accounts payable, mass payments, procurement, expenses and treasury in one connected suite.
Private American fintech company headquartered in Foster City, California; sells software for business payments and finance operations.

product_description.value: Supplier onboarding, invoice processing, global payouts, tax compliance, payment reconciliation, expense reimbursements, fraud prevention, currency management and self-billing invoices; adjacent procurement, expense management, virtual and physical cards and treasury.

Accounts Payable (supplier management, invoice processing, global payments, tax compliance, reconciliation, PO matching); Mass Payments (payee onboarding, self-billing, developer APIs, FX payments); Connected Suite (procurement, expenses, cards, treasury); and Tipalti AI agents.
Accounts payable, procurement, expense management and global payments automation software.
Accounts payable suite, a mass-payouts product for platforms, and a connected suite covering procurement, expense management, cards and treasury; AI agents for finance teams.
Accounts Payable, Mass Payments, a Connected Suite of procurement, expenses, virtual and physical cards and treasury, and Tipalti AI agents.
Mass payments platform and API, Tipalti Expenses (launched September 2023), fraud monitoring through Tipalti Detect, and the Tipalti Card.

business_model_description.value: Revenue comes mainly from SaaS subscriptions with tiered plans; entry plan at $149 per month, with higher tiers priced by transaction volume, number of entities and features.
Software-as-a-service business; companies can white-label its payments system, and it disburses funds from the customer's own bank account.

customer_description.value: Mid-market and fast-growing companies; one profile says it serves over 5,000 companies, another over 6,500 global companies.

Industries include music royalties, healthcare, affiliates and influencers, adtech, gaming, manufacturing and distribution, and e-commerce and retail; featured customers include ServiceRocket, A.Team, Matterport, Create Music Group, PubMatic and Lenus.
Mid-sized and large companies that pay contractors, employees, suppliers and vendors in more than 190 countries; early adopters were ad exchanges, ad networks, affiliate networks and publishers.
Mid-market firms of 50 to 1,000 employees; named high-velocity clients include Amazon Twitch, GoDaddy, Roku, WordPress.com and ZipRecruiter; Sacra reports over 4,000 customers.

Customers across many sectors, including Lantern Community Services, Chomps, Symphonic, PubMatic, Therabody, Hightouch, Scribd, Create Music Group, Matterport, ServiceRocket and A.Team; industries include music royalties, healthcare, affiliates and influencers, adtech, gaming and e-commerce.
Mid-sized and large companies paying contractors, employees, suppliers and vendors in many currencies across more than 190 countries.
